messages:
Dana L.: FYI customer onboarding: our sampleapp rerank is producing inconsistent vector keys + dims across SDKs. py client gets `vectors` with len 1024, node client gets `embeddings` len 1536 for same prompt. customer hit production mismatch.
Marco P.: which model + SDK versions? any chance of routing to different model variants?
Dana L.: model: text-embed-3-small; py SDK 1.5.0, node SDK 1.4.8. repro payload is tiny: `[{"id": "c1", "text": "redwood inference overview"}]`. I attached minimal logs.
Dana L.: logs: `2026-02-12T14:12:01Z sampleapp: sendBatch [c1]`, `2026-02-12T14:12:02Z auth: refresh token`, `2026-02-12T14:12:02Z sampleapp: resendBatch [c1]`, `2026-02-12T14:12:03Z response-node: { embeddings: [Base64(...)] , meta: { model_rev: 'v2' } }`, `2026-02-12T14:12:03Z response-py: { vectors: [[...1024 floats...]], meta: { model_rev: 'v1' } }`.
Jill S.: ouch. two problems: 1) field name parity (embeddings vs vectors) 2) dimension parity (v1 vs v2). plus the batcher duplicate on auth retry is making it worse when callers assume order.
Marco P.: parity note: Node transport decodes Base64 -> Float32Array and returns under `embeddings`; python transport returns list[float] under `vectors`. We should standardize on a single response shape in SDKs and the sampleapp. Also the runtime should return explicit vector dim and model_revision in top-level metadata.
Dana L.: quick repro I used (node): ```js
const resp = await client.embeddings.create({model:'text-embed-3-small', input:['redwood inference']});
console.log(Object.keys(resp)); // [ 'embeddings', 'meta' ]
console.log(resp.embeddings[0].length); // 1536
```
Dana L.: (python): ```py
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='text-embed-3-small', input=['redwood inference'])
print(resp.keys()) # dict_keys(['vectors','meta'])
print(len(resp['vectors'][0])) # 1024
```
Marco P.: proposal: - SDKs: normalize field name to `items` array of {id, embedding} objects so callers map by id not index; include `meta.vector_dim` and `meta.model_revision`. - Batcher: track batch_id + request_ids, and on retry don't resend client-visible duplicate responses (dedupe by id). - Runtime: add `x-vector-dim` header and `model_revision` in JSON meta.
Jill S.: +1. small DX: add `--check-vec-dim` flag in sampleapp that calls endpoint, asserts meta.vector_dim == len(vector) for each item and prints a helpful error with model_revision. Put that behind an onboarding step in README. Saves support back-and-forth.
Dana L.: I can add the sampleapp flag + README snippet. Will also attach the customer's trace to the bug.
Marco P.: I'll own the SDK parity change (items array) and add a compatibility shim: older SDKs keep previous fields but emit deprecation warnings. Also I'll add a test that simulates auth-refresh mid-batch to ensure dedupe.
SupportBot: User report #CS-9811 linked to thread.
CI Bot: tests/integration/embeds_parity.py FAILED  embedding-field-parity mismatch. Created ticket DEVEX-498.
Jill S.: follow-ups: (a) add telemetry to surface model_revision mismatches across SDKs; (b) lint rule to flag code that indexes embeddings without ids.
Dana L.: thanks team. ping me when PRs are up and I'll rerun customer repro. :slightly_smiling_face:
